title: Hide product video download and playback-speed options
summary: Remove the requested browser video menu options from website and Expo web product players; hide the Android player settings button.

changes.detail: Add nodownload and noplaybackrate controlsList tokens to website video markup and Expo web video elements. Disable Android settings button through Expo buttonOptions. Preserve native play/pause and seek controls.
